::: {.test-head title="Early river civilizations" unit="Section 1: what you know, in short answers" total="25" minutes="40"}
You may use your packet and notes. [2] = 2 marks; the lines show about how much to write. Section 2 is one paragraph (the next pages).
:::

::: short-answer
- [2] What does the Greek word *Mesopotamia* mean? Why is a Greek word used for this place? | The land between the rivers. Greek writers named it long after.
- [2/1] Name the two rivers that frame the Mesopotamian valley. | The Tigris and the Euphrates.
- [2/1] The Sumerians faced floods and droughts. Name ONE thing they built to control water. | Irrigation canals (or levees, dams, reservoirs).
- [2/1] Mesopotamia had no natural barriers. How did Sumerians protect their cities? | They built thick city walls (and armies).
- [3] What is *polytheism*? Name one Mesopotamian god and what they controlled. | Belief in many gods. Shamash: the sun and justice.
- [3] Compare the Mesopotamian view of the afterlife with your own, or with traditional Chinese ideas.
- [3] Look at the social pyramid. Who was at the top, and who at the bottom? Why? | Kings and priests at the top, enslaved people at the bottom: power came from the gods and land.
:::
